title: ALLaM: Large Language Models for Arabic and English

bias_targets.methodology: Automatic evaluation using the Arabic Cultural Value Alignment (ACVA) benchmark and AraTruthfulQA (localized for cultural appropriateness), alongside human evaluation and preference training on prompts targeting Middle Eastern culture, religions, and locale awareness.

Human evaluators conducted pairwise comparisons of model responses with explicit instructions to penalize outputs containing toxicity, hate speech, or general bias. Automatic safety and alignment evaluations were also conducted using the Hendrycks Ethics benchmark.
